stem: A canopy work order is clear for most plants, but one identified plant is visibly stressed and would exceed the supplied intervention threshold. What should the learner do?
choices: Apply the same work to every plant for consistency
Remove extra tissue to finish faster
Document the exception and hold/escalate the affected plant while completing authorized work that still meets the supplied standard
rationale: Uniform execution does not justify ignoring a condition that falls outside the supplied work standard.
